verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe shows a real index+search round trip: a document indexed with ?refresh=true was immediately found via a BM25 query, confirming near-real-time visibility without any full reindex. This is corroborated by a community comment explaining Elasticsearch's refresh mechanism and that faster refresh intervals can be configured for near-real-time behavior, with a performance trade-off noted. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explicitly describing the refresh/NRT search API and its guarantees/limits, and confirmation that updates and deletes (not just adds) become visible the same way.
